big_case.notes: Interim stay application by the SG against a classwide preliminary injunction (and APA section 705 stay) blocking a nationwide BOP policy on gender-dysphoria treatment and accommodations for roughly 2,000 federal inmates. The stakes are real for the affected class and the policy is national, but the Court denied it in a one-line order with two noted would-grant votes and no opinion. That leaves the merits to the D.C. Circuit's expedited appeal and sets no doctrine. Significant, but well below a merits ruling in the gender-identity line.
